pages.title: Thanks
pages.text: This book, and everything in it, did not appear out of nowhere.$(br2)$(li)$(l)Create$() (simibubi) — the mod this one grows on$(li)$(l)Touhou Little Maid$() (TartaricAcid) — all the maid support$(li)$(l)Patchouli$() (VazKii) — the book you are reading$(li)$(l)JEI$() (mezz) — how you look recipes up$(li)$(l)Cloth Config$() (shedaniel) — the config screen$(li)$(l)KubeJS$() — how scripts change things$(br2)And everyone who filed an issue, tried a build, or said "this part is wrong".$(br2)Thank you.
